detaileddescription.para: To support bitcode upgrades (and assembly semantic sugar) for MetadataAsValue, we need to canonicalize certain metadata.

listitem.para: nullptr is replaced by an empty MDNode.
An MDNode with a single null operand is replaced by an empty MDNode.
An MDNode whose only operand is a ConstantAsMetadata gets skipped.

detaileddescription.para: This maintains readability of bitcode from when metadata was a type of value, and these bridges were unnecessary.

briefdescription.para: Get a node or a self-reference that looks like it.

detaileddescription.para: Special handling for finding self-references, for use by MDNode::concatenate() and MDNode::intersect() to maintain behaviour from when self-referencing nodes were still uniqued. If the first operand has the same operands as Ops, return the first operand instead.
